First Aid (SR2 p.115). Biotech, for when a wound cannot wait for a professional. It treats Physical damage only — Stun comes back with rest and nothing else.

The golden hour

  • First aid must be applied within the first hour after the injury.
  • Once magical healing has been applied, first aid is of no further use — so treat first, then cast.

First Aid Table

Condition LevelTarget NumberTreatment Time
Light410 minutes

Target number modifiers

SituationModifier
Patient is a magician+2

Terrible conditions+3

Result

  • One or more successes reduces the Damage Level by one level — never more, however well you roll.
  • Divide the Biotech successes into the treatment time: the result is how many uninterrupted minutes it takes.
  • A serious interruption aborts the attempt, but it may be repeated.
  • A Deadly wound can only be stabilised, never healed, and the stabilisation must be maintained continuously until professional help arrives.

Treating a magician risks their Magic: the +2 can be skipped, but then roll 2D6 — a result at or under their current Magic Rating costs 1 point permanently. A Deadly wound treated without the +2 checks twice.

Trauma patch: a last-ditch stabiliser granting an extra Body Test at Target Number 4, plus the rating of any dermal armor or blood filter (both restrict the medicine). See p.114 for the lasting ill-effects.
